concept: A bright editorial instrument watches a crawler make a smart decision. crawl4ai reads a site the way a researcher does — it scores each page's relevance, follows only what matters, and stops the moment its confidence says it has learned enough. The runtime is a single rising measurement: a selective map, a climbing confidence curve, the STOP, the clean markdown it kept, and the receipt. Warm-paper world with teal as the one saturated pop; a single inverted dark beat at the STOP gives the light run a real color script.
money_shot_note: Scene 5 (THE_STOP) at ~65% of runtime: the confidence curve crosses the 'enough' line, the teal curve hits full glow on the threshold, and the crawl halts. This is the differentiator SHOWN — the crawler quitting on purpose. It reads as the peak via the biggest camera event (crash_zoom), the single foley button (riser_braam) landing exactly on the cross, and emphasize — not a polarity flip (the run stays all-light on purpose).
transition_strategy: Hard cuts throughout (no dissolve). Motion carries through each cut — the map is already spreading when s2 enters, the curve is already drawing when s3 enters. The one foley button (riser_braam) lands on the STOP cut only; no swipe between scenes.
music_direction: A clean electronic bed with a rising tension into ~65% that resolves on the STOP; steady, precise, not anthemic. Cut the picture to the track so the curve crosses the line on a beat.
